families.name: Critic configuration error
families.exercises: Where an error of the configuration of the critic ends. An error that the critic finds before its call (the phase is not in the spec; the spec or the phase evidence is missing; the format or the verification plan is invalid) ends with critic exit 3, engine exit 3 and the stop reason `critic_config`. An error that is raised inside the call (a missing key, an unknown harness name, an invalid reference of a harness) is scored MALFORMED and ends at the MALFORMED limit with engine exit 1 and the stop reason `critic_unavailable`
